sources.title: EVIE-8B: Tencent's Quiet Visual Document Retrieval Flagship
sources.snippet: The tencent/EVIE-8B model card above is the release's public surface: a visual-document-retrieval checkpoint tagged for the colpali-engine library, Apache-2.0 licensed, with a 4096-dimensional late-interaction embedding and the family's own refreshed ViDoRe table near the top of the card.
